data.gender_notes: Keyur is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Keyur is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Keyura', which means 'golden' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with the god Indra, who is known for his golden aura and celestial powers. Keyur represents brightness, radiance, and illumination in one's life. The name Keyur carries the meaning “Golden, Radiant, Bright” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Keyur usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, radiant, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
